_comment: Generator Service config: per-criterion specification (name + evidence_top_k - each criterion's content differs, so each needs a different amount of evidence) and the order criteria are generated in. No keywords (SRS FR-010: each Criterion Agent derives its own Data Request from its Target Slots) and no guideline / required_evidence (criterion rules and data completeness belong to Monitor's ps_requirements). Served to Master through the MCP get_master_config tool and validated by common/master_config.py.
